To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we develop an efficient decentralized consensus protocol for distributed systems that can reach the consensus in a minimal number of message steps and incur a much smaller number for messages than prior works.

the proposed decentralized consensus protocols with an initiator significantly outperforms prior works and the proposed protocols can adapt itself to the number and the communication topology of the nodes in the system and reach the consensus with the minimal number of message steps.
we develop an efficient multi-layer consensus protocol with an initator and the protocol significantly outperform prior works.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing an efficient and scalable decentralized consensus protocol for distributed systems.
the development of a decentralized consensus protocol with the following properties: 1) It is a multi-layered protocol.

a decentralized consensus protocol for the case that the distributed system has an initiator and it has the following three contributions: (i) it develops an efficient decentralized consensus protocol that is capable of adapting itself to the size of the system, (ii) it shows the superiority of its performance over prior protocols for the case of an initiator, and (iii) it is the first work in this area to exploit the concept of multi-layers for a decentralized consensus protocol.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed multi-layered decentralized protocol with an initiator is a novel and efficient decentralized consensus protocol.
, the proposed multi-layered decentralized protocols with an initiator are more efficient than prior works in both the message complexity and the number of message steps.
the decentralized consensus protocol with the initiator is superior to the decentralized consensus protocol without the initiator in terms of the number of message steps and the number of messages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the first decentralized consensus protocol with a proper initiator that fully exploits the intrinsic properties of the initiator and thus significantly outperform prior works.

the proposed protocol with an initiator is the first one which is able to achieve the optimal number of message steps and the optimal number of messages for the case where the number of nodes is known a priori.
, for the first time, we propose a multi-layered decentralized protocol with an initiator and show that it can significantly outperform prior works.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of an initiator in a distributed system is not a liability but a blessing.

by exploiting the concept of having an initiator and multi-layered execution we are able to develop a decentralized consensus protocol that can adapt itself to the number nodes in the system and thus can be much more efficient than prior works.
the initiator can be utilized to significantly improve the performance of the decentralized consensus protocols.
